run_ml_inference_her: run the ml_inference script to perform HER voltage prediction using computational and experimental CSV data
run_get_computational_df: run get_computational_df_to_predict to aggregate mean energies per bulk from a computational CSV or parquet file
run_volcano_plot: run the ml_inference script to generate a volcano plot of PC1 versus predicted voltage vs SHE
run_parity_plot: run the ml_inference script with cv_results_csv to generate a parity plot comparing experimental and predicted voltages
run_feature_engineering: run the ml_inference script with add_features to include matminer elemental features in the linear regression model
